SELECT 
  HOUR(tpep_dropoff_datetime) AS dropoff_hour,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_count
FROM nyctaxi.trips
WHERE trip_distance > 0 AND trip_distance < 10 AND fare_amount > 0 AND fare_amount < 50
GROUP BY HOUR(tpep_dropoff_datetime)
ORDER BY dropoff_hour

SELECT 'bakehouse.sales_transactions' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM bakehouse.sales_transactions
UNION ALL SELECT 'bakehouse.sales_customers', COUNT(*) FROM bakehouse.sales_customers
UNION ALL SELECT 'bakehouse.sales_franchises', COUNT(*) FROM bakehouse.sales_franchises
UNION ALL SELECT 'bakehouse.sales_suppliers', COUNT(*) FROM bakehouse.sales_suppliers
UNION ALL SELECT 'bakehouse.media_customer_reviews', COUNT(*) FROM bakehouse.media_customer_reviews
UNION ALL SELECT 'wanderbricks.bookings', COUNT(*) FROM wanderbricks.bookings
UNION ALL SELECT 'wanderbricks.users', COUNT(*) FROM wanderbricks.users
UNION ALL SELECT 'wanderbricks.properties', COUNT(*) FROM wanderbricks.properties
UNION ALL SELECT 'wanderbricks.payments', COUNT(*) FROM wanderbricks.payments
UNION ALL SELECT 'tpch.orders', COUNT(*) FROM tpch.orders
UNION ALL SELECT 'tpch.lineitem', COUNT(*) FROM tpch.lineitem
UNION ALL SELECT 'nyctaxi.trips', COUNT(*) FROM nyctaxi.trips
ORDER BY row_count DESC

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', dateTime) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  SUM(totalPrice) AS revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customerID) AS unique_customers
FROM bakehouse.sales_transactions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_value,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(check_out, check_in)), 1) AS avg_nights
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY bookings DESC

SELECT
  product,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(totalPrice) AS revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(unitPrice), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM bakehouse.sales_transactions
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_bookings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS cancel_rate_pct
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  n.n_name AS nation,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customers,
  COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(o.o_totalprice), 2) AS total_order_value
FROM tpch.nation n
JOIN tpch.customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN tpch.orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY total_order_value DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  r.r_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customers,
  COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM tpch.region r
JOIN tpch.nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN tpch.customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN tpch.orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN tpch.lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

SELECT
  paymentMethod,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  SUM(totalPrice) AS revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(totalPrice), 2) AS avg_transaction
FROM bakehouse.sales_transactions
GROUP BY paymentMethod
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT
  f.name AS franchise,
  f.city,
  f.country,
  f.size,
  COUNT(t.transactionID) AS transactions,
  SUM(t.totalPrice) AS revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.customerID) AS unique_customers
FROM bakehouse.sales_franchises f
LEFT JOIN bakehouse.sales_transactions t ON t.franchiseID = f.franchiseID
GROUP BY f.name, f.city, f.country, f.size
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  d.destination,
  d.country,
  COUNT(b.booking_id) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(b.total_amount), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(b.total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking
FROM wanderbricks.destinations d
JOIN wanderbricks.properties p ON p.destination_id = d.destination_id
JOIN wanderbricks.bookings b ON b.property_id = p.property_id
GROUP BY d.destination, d.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_4_plus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_star,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative
FROM wanderbricks.reviews

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN trip_distance < 1 THEN '< 1 mile'
    WHEN trip_distance < 3 THEN '1-3 miles'
    WHEN trip_distance < 5 THEN '3-5 miles'
    WHEN trip_distance < 10 THEN '5-10 miles'
    ELSE '10+ miles'
  END AS distance_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS trips,
  ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare,
  ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_miles,
  ROUND(AVG(fare_amount / NULLIF(trip_distance, 0)), 2) AS fare_per_mile
FROM nyctaxi.trips
GROUP BY distance_bucket
ORDER BY avg_fare

SELECT
  rating,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM wanderbricks.reviews
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating

SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS bookings,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct,
  ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_value,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY bookings DESC

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  d.destination,
  d.country,
  COUNT(b.booking_id) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(b.total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_value
FROM wanderbricks.bookings b
JOIN wanderbricks.properties p ON b.property_id = p.property_id
JOIN wanderbricks.destinations d ON p.destination_id = d.destination_id
WHERE b.status IN ('confirmed', 'completed')
GROUP BY d.destination, d.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS bookings,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct,
  ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_value,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY bookings DESC

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM wanderbricks.bookings
WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  d.destination,
  d.country,
  COUNT(b.booking_id) AS bookings,
  ROUND(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(b.total_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_value
FROM wanderbricks.bookings b
JOIN wanderbricks.properties p ON b.property_id = p.property_id
JOIN wanderbricks.destinations d ON p.destination_id = d.destination_id
WHERE b.status IN ('confirmed', 'completed')
GROUP BY d.destination, d.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  property_type,
  COUNT(*) AS properties,
  ROUND(AVG(base_price), 2) AS avg_base_price,
  ROUND(AVG(max_guests), 1) AS avg_max_guests
FROM wanderbricks.properties
GROUP BY property_type
ORDER BY properties DESC

-- Review score buckets (1-decimal ratings → group into whole stars)
SELECT
  FLOOR(rating) AS star_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS reviews,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM wanderbricks.reviews
WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
